groups.definition: Strained U.S.-China relations, including tariffs, sanctions, export controls and entity lists, could decouple trade and disrupt access to China-sourced components and materials.

groups.canonical_name: Armed conflict disrupting global supply chains
groups.definition: Wars and regional conflicts such as in the Middle East and Ukraine could disrupt supply chains, transportation and energy prices and weaken the global economy.

groups.canonical_name: Natural disaster and geopolitical facility disruption
groups.definition: Earthquakes, floods, climate events or geopolitical conflicts could damage company facilities or interrupt its supply chain.
